decision.selected_method: independent complete frozen-task physical replay of the current quasistatic feedforward schedule

decision.hypothesis: The unresolved physical uncertainty is whether the current candidate's statically constructed equilibrium sequence remains accurate when interpolated and applied to the actual 22 s dynamics. Competing hypotheses are: (H1) the 0.1 Hz motion is sufficiently quasistatic that the feedforward schedule tracks within every frozen acceptance bound; or (H2) dynamic lag, interpolation error, unilateral tension behavior, actuator limits, drift, contact, or numerical instability causes failure despite the accurate static equilibria. The static bank and time-zero qualification cannot discriminate these hypotheses.
decision.expected_observation: Under H1, one complete independent replay finishes all 22 s without numerical failure, contact, or warnings and reports tracking RMSE at most 0.003 m, maximum error at most 0.006 m, cycle drift at most 0.002 m, the required lobe coverage, four independent channels, tensions within 0.2–8 N without forbidden saturation, stroke at most 0.03 m, speed at most 0.03 m/s, and the already qualified initial static balance at most 1e-7 Nm.
decision.weakening_observation: H1 is refuted for this schedule if the complete replay is invalid or incomplete, or if any unchanged acceptance check fails—especially phase-correlated tracking lag, RMSE above 0.003 m, maximum error above 0.006 m, cycle drift above 0.002 m, missed lobe coverage, tension saturation, excessive stroke or speed, contact, warnings, or numerical termination. Such a result supports H2 for this feedforward schedule but does not prove the structure or task globally infeasible.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep frozen task T04/default, candidate a2b86a9c493cbc5d15bc37f341f86ec0600f418522b41f8e8c8d3de8fc92884f, source schedule 826caeba0d084a7aa0062ffd14194112ea115f7cff615ad4c522837fbb9c14b2, qualified candidate equilibrium, seed 17, 22 s reference and timing, gravity, payload and pointer geometry, collision policy, actuator semantics, four channels, and every original acceptance threshold unchanged.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after this single complete replay is registered; accept no conclusion from a partial rollout. If it passes every original check, it is eligible as complete physical task evidence. If it fails, retain the full traces and diagnose the dominant dynamic or constraint failure before any control or design revision.
decision.interpretation: T04-216/f7dff6a0 establishes only sampled static mathematical equilibria, including maximum static position error about 0.611 mm and residual about 5.08e-12 Nm; T04-217/93df2cb6 establishes only time-zero static qualification; T04-218/bca3ab77 establishes task binding; and T04-219/fa45b8b with source 826caeba establishes an unmeasured schedule. Only the proposed complete independent physical replay can resolve the present dynamic physical uncertainty and test the unchanged task acceptance criteria.
